definitions.short: a Tekoite or inhabitant of Tekoah
definitions.full: H8621. Teqoi תְּקֹעִי תְּקוֺעִי, adjective, of a people of foregoing: ׳הַתּ 2Sam 23:26 = 1Chr 11:28 ; 27:9 ; feminine הַתְּקֹעִית הָאִשָּׁה 2Sam 14:4 , 9 ; plural as substantive הַתְּקוֺעִים Neh 3:5 , 27 .

occurrences.englishText: When the woman of Tekoa spoke to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, showed respect, and said, “Help, O king!”
The woman of Tekoa said to the king, “My lord, O king, may the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house; and may the king and his throne be guiltless.”
Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the Lord’s work.
After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, opposite the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.
